chunks: From him, from al-Hasan ibn 'Ali al-Washsha', from Jamil ibn Darrāj and Muhammad ibn Humrān, from Mansur ibn Hazim, from Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:

At whatever hour the woman sees blood, then she breaks the fast of the fasting woman when she menstruates. And if she sees purity at any hour of the day, she makes up the prayer of the day and the night.

key_terms.الدَّمَ: menstrual blood seen by the woman
key_terms.الْيَوْمِ وَاللَّيْلَةِ: the day and the night prayers
key_terms.تُفَطِّرُ: she breaks the fast; her fast is no longer valid
key_terms.قَضَتْ: she makes up what is due later

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a woman begins menstruation while fasting in Ramadan or becomes pure during the day?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding a woman who menstruates during a day of Ramadan and regarding the return of ritual purity during the daytime. It states that the onset of menstruation nullifies her fasting, and if she becomes pure during the day, she must make up the prayer of that day and night.
